ideas.pitch: Real-time digital twin and predictive anomaly detection platform for industrial manufacturing equipment using sensor telemetry streams.

ideas.pitch: Computer vision system that monitors manufacturing shop floors and construction sites for personal protective equipment (PPE) compliance and safety hazards in real-time.

ideas.title: VigilantVision-EHS
